I.value_zh: 两篇具名文章及应嵌入的 6 张聊天截图；原文未列出六张截图的可核验文件身份或位置。
I.value_en: Two named articles and six chat screenshots to embed; the source does not identify the six image files or their accessible locations.
I.notes_zh: 不读取或补造图片资产。
I.notes_en: No image assets are read or fabricated.

O.value_zh: 两篇文章末尾直接展示六张对应聊天截图；中文附记为“附记：聊天截图”，英文附记、说明文字与截图标题为英文。
O.value_en: Both article endings directly display the six corresponding chat screenshots; the Chinese appendix is “附记：聊天截图” and the English appendix, explanatory text and screenshot titles are in English.
O.notes_zh: 输出要求已明确；图片文件身份仍属于未绑定输入，不补造目标路径。
O.notes_en: Output requirements are explicit; image identity remains an unbound input and target paths are not fabricated.

A.value_zh: 在中文文章末尾加入“附记：聊天截图”并嵌入 6 张截图；在英文文章末尾加入英文 appendix/note、翻译说明文字和截图标题；保留题图、正文和证据索引链接。
A.value_en: Append “附记：聊天截图” and embed six screenshots at the Chinese article end; add an English appendix/note with translated text and screenshot titles at the English article end; preserve cover, body and evidence-index links.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为要求方；ME 为收件人和被指派主体。
P.value_en: ADMIN is requester; ME is recipient and assigned actor.

R.value_zh: 原文未设执行期限或资源预算；P2 是优先级，六张截图是交付范围而非资源配额。
R.value_en: The source sets no execution deadline or resource budget; P2 is priority and six screenshots define delivery scope rather than a resource quota.
R.notes_zh: 数量约束已保留在截图作用域。
R.notes_en: The count requirement remains in screenshot scope.

V.value_zh: 原文未提供适用规范或版本依据，也未要求另附图片使用或发布依据。
V.value_en: No applicable standard or version basis is supplied, and the source does not require a separate image-use or publication basis.

C.value_zh: 两篇文章底部直接可见对应截图，英文附记和截图标题为英文，Markdown 无诊断错误；可对实际交付文件核对。
C.value_en: The corresponding screenshots are directly visible at both article endings, the English appendix and screenshot titles are in English, and Markdown has no diagnostics; the delivered files can be checked.
C.notes_zh: 图片输入身份待绑定，但验收谓词不因此变成未定义。
C.notes_en: The image inputs remain unbound, but the acceptance predicates remain defined.

B.value_zh: 不得改变现有题图、正文和证据索引链接。
B.value_en: Existing cover image, body and evidence-index links must not be changed.
